candidate: Apitegromab (existing candidate; no new drug identity)
disposition: Retain as the strongest pediatric human motor-function comparator in the selected shortlist, but distinguish the positive pooled-dose primary test from the nonsignificant single high-dose test and exploratory lower-dose/secondary estimates.

primary_trial.citation: Crawford TO et al. Safety and efficacy of apitegromab in nonambulatory type 2 or type 3 spinal muscular atrophy (SAPPHIRE): a phase 3, double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled trial. Lancet Neurol. 2025;24(9):727-739. PMID 40818473; DOI 10.1016/S1474-4422(25)00225-X.
primary_trial.design: 52-week, multicentre, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 3 trial at 48 hospitals in nine countries; 216 screened, 188 randomised.
primary_trial.population: Nonambulatory, genetically documented SMN-deficient SMA type 2/3; ages 2-21; baseline HFMSE 10-45; on nusinersen for at least 10 months or risdiplam for at least 6 months. Main efficacy population ages 2-12 (n=156); exploratory ages 13-21 (n=32).

combined_10_and_20_mg_kg_vs_placebo.status: Prespecified primary comparison; passed Hochberg at p<=0.025.

20_mg_kg_vs_placebo.status: Second prespecified primary comparison; did not pass. Gatekeeping stopped after Step 1.

10_mg_kg_vs_placebo.status: Step 5 of the prespecified hierarchy; exploratory because the 20 mg/kg primary test failed.

secondary_outcomes.interpretation: All secondary tests are exploratory under the prespecified hierarchy; the EU registry supplies no inferential tests for them.

primary_trial.analysis: Protocol V3.0 dated 2024-06-11 and SAP V1.0 dated 2024-08-30 prespecified simultaneous Hochberg tests for pooled 10+20 mg/kg and 20 mg/kg alone, then a gated secondary sequence. Primary endpoint was MMRM in the mITT set; article reports missing-at-random handling. The main primary comparison passed and 20 mg/kg did not, so subsequent comparisons were exploratory.
primary_trial.safety: Published article reports no treatment-related serious adverse events, no AE-related discontinuations and no deaths; SAE incidence was 21/128 (16%) for pooled apitegromab versus 6/60 (10%) placebo, mainly infection/respiratory and assessed unrelated. The current FDA label separately reports fractures: 5/53 at 10 mg/kg, 3/53 at 20 mg/kg and 1/50 placebo.
primary_trial.sponsor_role: Scholar Rock funded the study and was responsible for design, SAP, drug procurement, trial management/conduct, and oversight of data collection and analysis; an independent data monitoring committee also reviewed safety.
primary_trial.competitive_interpretation: No change to the provisional candidate pair. Apitegromab remains the strongest pediatric human motor-function comparator in the selected set, but its confirmatory result is pooled-dose in SMA; the labeled 10 mg/kg single-dose estimate is exploratory under the hierarchy. No BUB1B/MVA transfer is demonstrated.

source_scope.full_main_article: All 13 pages of the published article were reviewed; pages were rendered and visually inspected, and OCR was used only as a reading aid.
source_scope.protocol_and_sap: Targeted endpoint, estimand, analysis-set, missing-data, and multiplicity sections read in full from the official 94-page Protocol Amendment V3.0 and 79-page SAP V1.0.
source_scope.euctr: Current results page sections for trial identity/design, disposition, baseline, endpoints, and adverse events reviewed; version 1 posted 2026-01-03.
